newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end lower, uncertainty prevails.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end lower, uncertainty prevails.

text.p: 1715 GMT - Portuguese shares closed lower in light turnover of 6.1 billion escudos amid uncertainties over the trend of foreign markets, dealers said. The PSI-20 .PSI20 index of 20 leading shares has fallen more than two percent this week after strong gains earlier in the year. The drop mirrors the trend on Wall Street, which opened sharply lower today.
* Sonae Investimentos recovered after a bout of pessimism hit the stock following the release of its 1996 results on Monday. It closed at 5,297 escudos, up 66, in volume of 145,439.
* Dealers said the market would remain uncertain ahead of a U.S. Fed meeting on rates on March 25. "The market will be unstable, shifting with the foreign trend," said one operator.
* The most active stocks included Portugal Telecom and troubled ship repairer Lisnave.
